user_review.method: Prior live maintainer run through the signed-in YouTube UI, replay of the separately observed source and saved ID sequences, and independent first-use simulations of the revised instructions. The public evidence contains no account or private playlist identifiers.

scenarios.request: Finish an existing private YouTube playlist with only one of twelve intended tracks saved.
scenarios.expected: Save the eleven missing recordings to the same playlist and reopen it from the account library to compare all twelve positions.
scenarios.observed: In the live run, the native Add videos picker accepted exact watch URLs. The reopened private playlist kept the same ID and all twelve ordered video IDs matched. The revised instructions reuse those UI steps.

scenarios.request: Verify an attempted save when only the first track remains, or all tracks arrive in the wrong order.
scenarios.expected: Reject both incomplete membership and equal-count order mismatches.
scenarios.observed: Replay of the native read-back matched twelve out of twelve. The same comparison rejected a one-track result with eleven missing IDs and a twelve-track result with the first two swapped.

scenarios.request: Create a new four-track YouTube mix, then simulate an interrupted save and a sign-in blocker.
scenarios.expected: Use one private playlist, retain all intended IDs before writing, resume by exact playlist ID, and wait for authorization if the account is inaccessible.
scenarios.observed: Independent walkthrough reached one native save and one account read-back. It exposed a missing pre-write checkpoint. The skill now records intended IDs before writes and the playlist ID once it exists, then reads saved state before retrying.

scenarios.request: Give me one preview import link where I can choose between Apple Music and Spotify.
scenarios.expected: Keep both choices available in Soundiiz and leave account delivery pending.
scenarios.observed: The instruction walkthrough selected the catalog-checked import route with no preset destination and no account write. Existing poster tests also confirmed unset destinations are omitted.

similar_skills.learned: The author supports adding by a native recording URI and listing the saved playlist in a separate operation.
similar_skills.reason: Apply exact video IDs and read the stable playlist separately. Keep intended repeats and avoid title search as a substitute for a pinned recording.

similar_skills.learned: The browser workflow takes a fresh semantic observation after actions or navigation.
similar_skills.reason: Use a fresh saved-playlist view after writes, with the existing authorized browser and no fixed element references or new browser dependency.

validation.observed: 24 offline tests passed for catalog matching, Soundiiz acceptance and destination choice, ordered YouTube comparison, and exact-ID reconciliation.

scenarios.request: Reuse a catalog-checked mix whose destination is explicitly unset in JSON.

scenarios.observed: The previous poster sent destination: null and the real endpoint returned HTTP 400. The candidate stripped null on the same catalog-verified payload. Soundiiz accepted all five tracks and the returned preview opened.

scenarios.request: Preselect Apple Music, Spotify, or YouTube Music explicitly.
scenarios.expected: Preserve the requested service corename through the handoff.
scenarios.observed: Poster regression confirmed applemusicapp, spotify and ytmusic pass through unchanged; Soundiiz documentation distinguishes plain YouTube (youtube) from YouTube Music (ytmusic).

similar_skills.reason: Show a reproducible preview link and accepted count. Keep destination save as a separate result because Mixtape transfers through Soundiiz.

similar_skills.learned: A usable candidate tracklist and creating a playlist have distinct confirmation points.
similar_skills.reason: Preserve the real Soundiiz preview and customer confirmation. Skip Spotify-specific developer credentials or direct account writes, which the public import API does not require.
